hero.theme: ₹50. One Person. One Meal. One Month.
hero.description: You don't have to do everything to help someone. Sometimes, one small contribution can become someone's meal.

monthlyMission.intro: You don't have to do everything to help someone. Sometimes, one small contribution can become someone's meal.
monthlyMission.description: A simple ₹50 monthly contribution can become part of a collective effort to support food-related initiatives and people who need support.

transparency.description: We don't ask you to blindly trust us. We invite you to understand how your contribution moves through the journey and what impact it creates.
transparency.footer: Every contribution should have a visible journey.

founder.headingDescription: A simple belief in helping others grew into a vision for building a transparent and compassionate food-support movement.
founder.imageAlt: Manisha Nigam, Founder of Hanumat Seva Foundation
founder.paragraph1: For over a decade, Manisha Nigam has been personally involved in helping people and supporting communities in need in Kanpur.
founder.paragraph2: Her journey has been driven not by the idea of building an organization, but by a simple human responsibility — if we can help someone, we should.
founder.paragraph3: Seeing the everyday reality of hunger and food wastage inspired her to think beyond individual acts of help and create a system that could allow many more people to participate.
founder.paragraph4: Hanumat Seva Foundation is an effort to turn that belief into a larger, organized movement.
founder.quote: Seva does not begin with how much we have. It begins with how much we are willing to share.

vision.label: OUR VISION
vision.title: What We Want to Build
vision.paragraph1: We don't want to be just another organization that distributes food.
vision.paragraph2: We want to build an ecosystem where food rescue becomes simple, transparent, and scalable.

points.one: A restaurant should be able to report surplus food in seconds.
points.two: A volunteer should be able to find a nearby pickup.
points.three: An organization should be able to request meals.
points.four: A donor should be able to see the impact of their contribution.
points.five: Every meal should have a journey that can be understood and trusted.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about Hanumant Seva and our initiatives.

donate.question: How can I donate?
donate.answer: You can donate online through our donation page or contribute groceries and food materials during our food drives.

volunteer.question: Can I volunteer on weekends?
volunteer.answer: Yes. Most of our food distribution programs are conducted on weekends and public holidays.

foodDrives.question: Where are your food drives conducted?
foodDrives.answer: We organize food drives across different communities, orphanages, old age homes, and public locations where support is needed.

tax.question: Is my donation tax deductible?
tax.answer: Once your NGO is registered under the applicable Indian regulations (such as 80G), eligible donations may qualify for tax benefits.
